title: The Hiring
description: Can a 258 lb dad run a sub-3 marathon? I hired five AI coaches to find out, and they argue over every run. This is the morning they got hired.
writeup: In October, the first time I asked my Garmin about a marathon, it said 4:39:49. My goal for Chicago is 2:59:59. That was the gap on the morning I hired the coaches.
Kai wants the running done his way. Bo wants heavy legs, and Kai has something to say about when. Before I’ve run a mile for them, they have to agree on a week.
The figures in this episode are from the start of the story. The watch estimate changes with the training; the current numbers are on the home page.
All five coaches are animated AI characters with AI voices. The training is mine.
garmin: the first marathon prediction was 4:39:49 on October 19. On November 21 it read 4:36:10.
